dedupe_keys.name: ofgem riio energy network price controls decisions outputs and incentives for gb electricity and gas networks

description: Ofgem, the energy regulator for Great Britain, sets price controls for the companies that own and run the electricity and gas transmission and distribution networks under the RIIO framework (Revenue = Incentives + Innovation + Outputs). Price controls limit the revenue companies may earn, reward improvements in service, fund innovation and define outputs covering safety, environment, customer satisfaction, social obligations, network connections, reliability and availability. The price control pages list RIIO-T3 for electricity and gas transmission and RIIO-GD3 for gas distribution (both 2026 to 2031), RIIO-ED3 for electricity distribution (2028 to 2033) and the previous RIIO-2 controls (T2 and GD2 2021 to 2026, ED2 2023 to 2028), each with regulations, consultations, decisions and guidance. Coverage: Great Britain's network companies. Format and access: HTML pages with linked publications; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): OGL-UK-3.0 for Crown copyright material (Ofgem copyright page). Caveats: only the price control landing page was read; the annual network performance reports and their data tables were not located, because the site's search is script-driven. Simulation uses: allowed investment, reliability targets and output incentives for capacity planning and resilience studies of GB networks. Related records: the NESO data portal (data-neso-data-portal) publishes system operator data for the same networks.
